description: Principal Bicycle Network is a dataset listed in Lake Macquarie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Lake Macquarie City Council. The Lake Macquarie Walking, Cycling and Better Streets Strategy sets out a vision for a Principal Bicycle Network connecting major centres and places across the City, and beyond to Newcastle and the Central Coast. Coverage: Lake Macquarie, New South Wales. The portal files it under Infrastructure and Communications. Its keywords are Cycling, Pedestrian, Wayfinding, Planning, Pathways, Cycleways. The portal shows 35 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lakemac-com-au-portal.
